audit: erun terraform plan --dry-run team dev
terraform: plan in <TMP> (env team/dev, type local-agent, namespace team-dev)
terraform: var file dev.tfvars
terraform: state <STATE_ROOT>/team/dev/terraform.tfstate (this host's home directory)
terraform: TF_DATA_DIR <STATE_ROOT>/team/dev/data
mkdir -p <STATE_ROOT>/team/dev
cd <TMP> && terraform plan -input=false -var-file=dev.tfvars
